source: the stylesheet bodies read during live loads of the marketing home and /pricing on dock.us plus the auth app on auth.dock.us/login (the linked cdn.prod.website-files.com Webflow bundles and the auth app’s inline emotion <style> blocks, from network responses and the CSSOM, re-parsed with CSSStyleSheet); resolved in a probe carrying the real sheets, plain (:root) and under data-theme="dark" class="chakra-ui-dark" (the Chakra dark scope) at 1440 x 900

properties.--hero-dot-mask: radial-gradient(circle at var(--hero-wave-origin,50% 150%), transparent calc(var(--hero-wave-radius) - var(--hero-wave-width)), #fff calc(var(--hero-wave-radius) - var(--hero-wave-width) / 2), transparent var(--hero-wave-radius))

properties.--editor-banner-height: calc(2 * var(--space-6) + 3 * var(--space-8) + var(--space-3) + var(--text-lead) * var(--control-line-height))
